proposal.reason: Across all 13 scaffolds, the maximum observed TTTAGGG copy count at either end is only one within the measured 10 kb window. That is not a convincing terminal repeat signal or evidence of chromosome completeness. With no prior attempts and three remaining, one conservative compatible-tail patch attempt can test whether HiFi reads provide stronger terminal motif and junction evidence. Require at least three supporting reads; do not lower support merely to obtain extensions. Review candidate alignments and rejection reasons before accepting any patch. The reference-based QUAST report flags 338 misassemblies and does not independently validate a terminal extension. Human approval is required before running.
